outcome: Prevalence of depression in pregnant women
Preferred mode of delivery (Caesarean section or vaginal delivery)
Relationship between depression, mode of delivery, and other demographic parameters
cohort: 250 pregnant women referring to hospitals of Shahid Beheshti University of Medical Sciences, Tehran, Iran
finding: While no significant association was found between depression in pregnant women and their preferred mode of delivery, this study found that increasing maternal age was associated with a greater preference for cesarean delivery, and a history of previous abortions was associated with higher depression scores.
mod_finding: The choice of delivery method was not significantly associated with depression in pregnant mothers.
